data.one_liner: Umeng Common SDK plugin for Flutter, providing analytics and push support on Android, iOS and HarmonyOS.
data.what_it_does: It initializes the Umeng SDK with an app key and optional push secret, enabling event tracking and push notifications. The plugin exposes a simple API to configure and use Umeng services in a Flutter app.
use_when: You need analytics and push notification integration for an Android/iOS app using Umeng.
You want a single plugin that handles both initialization and configuration for Umeng services.
avoid_when: You are targeting only web or desktop platforms, as the plugin supports only Android, iOS and HarmonyOS.
You already use another analytics provider and do not need Umeng.
strengths: Supports null safety and HarmonyOS platform.
Provides both analytics and push in one package.
weaknesses: No support for web or desktop.
Limited to Umeng ecosystem; no alternative SDKs exposed.
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, call UMConfigure.init in main or App class, provide app key and optional push secret.
